name: AgentBridge
description: A single-PC encrypted WebSocket relay. No database or server-side file storage.

BRIDGE_DEVICE_TOKEN.description: Relay access token for the Windows tray client. Keep private.

BRIDGE_CONTROLLER_TOKEN.description: Different relay access token for the controller. Keep private.

WEB_CONCURRENCY.description: This intentionally stateless single-PC relay runs one process on one dyno.
